testCase:
T-07: Back to the first page, and a new page size
Goal: Show the table with 25 rows per page, starting from the first page.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/t-07/
STEP 2: Click "Next" twice
STEP 3: Click "Go to first page"
STEP 4: Click "Next"
STEP 5: Choose "25" in "Rows per page"
STEP 6: Verify "Page size 25: back on page 1 of 4" is visible

plan.title: T-07: Reset pagination with 25 rows per page

steps.note: Move off the first page before changing page size.
Set the page size to 25 rows.

args.text: Page size 25: back on page 1 of 4

steps.note: Verify the new page size resets pagination to page 1 of 4.

reasoning: This tests that changing the table page size to 25 returns pagination to the first page. The plan follows the specified navigation sequence and checks the exact final status message.
